deltas.title_id: Bersiap, Coretax Dijadwalkan Downtime pada 5–8 Juni 2026
deltas.title_en: Prepare: Coretax Scheduled for Downtime 5–8 June 2026
deltas.impact_note: All Coretax-dependent tax filings, VAT returns, and refund requests will be inaccessible 5–8 June 2026; clients must complete any pending tax actions before 5 June.
deltas.summary: DJP has announced scheduled maintenance downtime for the Coretax tax administration system from 5 to 8 June 2026. All Coretax services will be temporarily disabled. Taxpayers are advised to complete any pending transactions before the maintenance window.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Waktu henti berdampak pada tidak dapat diaksesnya Coretax DJP dan semua layanan dinonaktifkan sementara.

deltas.title_id: Ada Tanggal Merah, Batas Setor dan Lapor PPN Masa Pajak April Mundur
deltas.title_en: Due to Public Holiday, PPN Filing and Payment Deadline for April Tax Period Postponed
deltas.impact_note: April 2026 PPN payment and filing deadline moves from 31 May to 2 June 2026; clients with pending VAT obligations must act by 2 June to avoid penalties.
deltas.summary: Under Articles 94(3)(e), 171(13) and 173(1) of PMK 81/2024, the April 2026 VAT periodic return deadline is automatically extended to 2 June 2026 because 30–31 May are weekends and 1 June is Pancasila Day (national holiday).
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Dalam hal batas akhir pelaporan ... bertepatan dengan hari libur, pelaporan dapat dilakukan paling lambat pada hari kerja berikutnya.

deltas.title_id: Simak, Ini Kondisi yang Buat Tombol Pengembalian Pendahuluan Aktif
deltas.title_en: Conditions That Activate the Preliminary VAT Refund Button in Coretax / PMK 28/2026 on Accelerated VAT Restitution
deltas.impact_note: PMK 28/2026 introduces new restrictions on VAT and tax overpayment refund (SKPLB) claims processed through Coretax, tightening eligibility criteria and adding formal/material review steps that affect business cash flow and investment planning for clients with refund claims.
deltas.summary: PMK Nomor 28 Tahun 2026 governs accelerated VAT restitution via Coretax, introducing automatic initial validation of preliminary refund eligibility and adding formal and material review steps before approval. Kadin Indonesia and tax academics have flagged that the regulation's restrictions on SKPLB claims create cash flow uncertainty for businesses and may affect investment decisions. The coretax system activates the preliminary refund button only for taxpayers with qualifying facilities.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Seiring dengan berlakunya PMK 28/2026, sistem coretax otomatis melakukan validasi awal pengembalian pendahuluan berdasarkan status fasilitas wajib pajak.

deltas.title_id: Surat Edaran Nomor IMI-417.GR.01.01 Tahun 2025 tentang Kewajiban Foto dan Wawancara WNA di Kantor Imigrasi
deltas.title_en: Circular Letter No. IMI-417.GR.01.01/2025 on Mandatory In-Person Photo and Interview for Foreign Nationals Renewing Stay Permits
deltas.impact_note: All foreign national clients renewing any stay permit (KITAS/KITAP) must appear in person at the immigration office for photo and interview; remote or agent-only renewals are no longer permissible under this circular effective 29 May 2025.
deltas.summary: Effective 29 May 2025, all foreign nationals (WNA) in Indonesia must personally attend their local immigration office for biometric photo capture and interview when renewing izin tinggal (stay permits). Online pre-registration remains mandatory before the in-person appointment. This fundamentally changes the renewal workflow for all Bali Zero KITAS/KITAP clients.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Mengacu kepada Surat Edaran Nomor IMI-417.GR.01.01 Tahun 2025 yang efektif berlaku mulai 29 Mei 2025, WNA yang berada di Indonesia wajib melakukan pengambilan foto dan wawancara di kantor imigrasi saat mengajukan perpanjangan izin tinggal.

deltas.citation: Keputusan Direktur Jenderal Pajak (KPP Wajib Pajak Besar/Madya relokasi efektif 1 Juli 2026)
deltas.title_id: Menyongsong Era Baru Perpajakan: Dampak Perpindahan Wajib Pajak terhadap Kepatuhan
deltas.title_en: Welcoming a New Tax Era: Impact of Taxpayer Relocation on Compliance — Large and Mid-Size Corporate Taxpayers Moved to Specialised Tax Offices Effective 1 July 2026
deltas.impact_note: Large PT PMA clients, multinationals, and high-net-worth individuals will be administratively transferred to KPP Wajib Pajak Besar or KPP Madya from 1 July 2026, requiring updated tax office registration and potentially changed filing procedures.
deltas.summary: DJP issued a decision ordering the administrative relocation of large corporate taxpayers — including state-owned enterprises, multinationals, digital banks, mining, manufacturing, and strategic high-net-worth individuals — to specialised tax offices (KPP Wajib Pajak Besar/LTO and KPP Madya), effective 1 July 2026. The move aims to consolidate oversight of high-value contributors and improve transparency.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Kebijakan ini memindahkan tempat pendaftaran dan pelaporan usaha bagi ratusan entitas bisnis skala besar, Badan Usaha Milik Negara (BUMN), perusahaan multinasional, hingga wajib pajak orang pribadi strategis ke unit khusus... berlaku efektif mulai 1 Juli 2026.

deltas.title_id: Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 112 Tahun 2025 tentang Anti-Abuse of Tax Treaty (Principal Purpose Test)
deltas.title_en: Ministry of Finance Regulation No. 112/2025 on Anti-Abuse of Tax Treaties — Principal Purpose Test
deltas.impact_note: Foreign investors using Indonesian tax treaties to reduce withholding tax on dividends, royalties, or interest must now demonstrate that the treaty arrangement has genuine commercial purpose (Principal Purpose Test), or risk treaty benefit denial.
deltas.summary: PMK 112/2025 introduces the Principal Purpose Test (PPT) for anti-abuse of tax treaties in Indonesia, aligning with OECD BEPS minimum standards. Treaty benefits will be denied where the principal purpose of an arrangement is to obtain a tax advantage.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Understanding the Principal Purpose Test, Rules on Anti-Abuse of Tax Treaty in PMK 112/2025

deltas.title_id: Peraturan Bank Indonesia Nomor 10 Tahun 2025 tentang Regulasi Industri Sistem Pembayaran
deltas.title_en: Bank Indonesia Regulation No. 10/2025 on Payment System Industry Regulation
deltas.impact_note: Companies operating payment system businesses or fintech in Indonesia must comply with tightened risk management and structural requirements under BI Reg 10/2025, which came into force 31 March 2026.
deltas.summary: Enacted 24 December 2025, came into force 31 March 2026. Strengthens payment system industry structure and risk management in Indonesia, implementing the Indonesian Payment System Blueprint 2030. Relevant for foreign-invested companies in fintech, e-commerce, and investment.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: On 24 December 2025, the Bank of Indonesia enacted Bank of Indonesia Regulation No 10 of 2025 on the Regulation of the Payment System Industry (BI Reg 10/2025). This regulation will come into force on 31 March 2026.

deltas.title_id: Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 28 Tahun 2025 tentang Perizinan Berusaha (OSS RBA)
deltas.title_en: Government Regulation No. 28/2025 on Business Licensing (OSS RBA system transition)
deltas.impact_note: Clients with in-progress business licensing projects started before 5 October 2025 must use the legacy 'Data Lama' OSS submission pathway to complete pending permits, while new projects follow the updated OSS RBA framework under PP 28/2025.
deltas.summary: PP 28/2025 governs the transition of business licensing under the OSS RBA system, effective 5 October 2025. Projects with spatial planning requirements (tata ruang) already issued but business licenses not yet completed before that date must use the legacy data pathway.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Bagi Pelaku Usaha yang memiliki data proyek transisi sebelum penerapan PP 28 (5 Oktober 2025) dengan persyaratan tata ruang telah terbit namun perizinan berusahanya belum rampung, silakan mengakses panduan Pengajuan Perizinan Berusaha (Data Lama).

deltas.title_id: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 27 Tahun 2026 tentang Perlindungan Pekerja Transportasi Online
deltas.title_en: Presidential Regulation No. 27/2026 on Online Transport Worker Protection
deltas.impact_note: Companies employing or contracting online transport workers (ojek online, delivery) in Indonesia must comply with the new worker protection framework, which may affect employment contracts and social security obligations for foreign-invested companies in logistics or platform businesses.
deltas.summary: Announced on May Day 2026 (1 May 2026) by President Prabowo alongside UU 2/2026. Provides a legal protection framework for online transportation workers, including minimum income guarantees and social security access. Relevant for PT PMA clients in the gig economy or digital platform sector.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Kebijakan baru tersebut meliputi Undang-Undang Nomor 2 Tahun 2026 tentang Pelindungan Pekerja Rumah Tangga (PPRT), Peraturan Presiden No. 27 Tahun 2026 tentang Perlindungan Pekerja Transportasi Online.

deltas.title_id: Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 136 Tahun 2024 tentang Global Minimum Tax (GloBE)
deltas.title_en: Ministry of Finance Regulation No. 136/2024 on Global Minimum Tax implementation (GloBE base law)
deltas.impact_note: Multinational groups with consolidated revenue above EUR 750 million operating in Indonesia are subject to the 15% GloBE minimum tax under PMK 136/2024; PER-6/PJ/2026 (already seen) provides the technical reporting guidelines for compliance.
deltas.summary: PMK 136/2024 is the primary legal basis for the Global Anti-Base Erosion (GloBE) minimum tax in Indonesia, targeting large multinational enterprise groups. It is the parent regulation implemented technically by PER-6/PJ/2026 (seen in yesterday's batch). Included here as contextual background for clients receiving advice on the GloBE reporting obligations.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PER-6/PJ/2026 merupakan peraturan pelaksana atas Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 136 Tahun 2024 yang menjadi acuan utama dalam implementasi GloBE.
